LanguageData.VGE_Astrofuel.label: REPCONN astrofuel
LanguageData.VGE_Astrofuel.description: A volatile high-energy propellant developed for REPCONN and USSA aerospace systems. It powers Hellion thrusters, boosters, and specialized generators, and burns violently even in low-oxygen compartments.
LanguageData.VGE_Astropurifier.label: astrofuel purifier
LanguageData.VGE_Astropurifier.description: A REPCONN precision processor that stabilizes astrofuel synthesis. Installed beside a synthesizer, it permits lossless conversion of chemfuel into astrofuel at the cost of a slower cycle.
LanguageData.VGE_GiantAstrofuelTank.description: A monumental REPCONN astrofuel tank built to supply the largest Hellion thruster arrays.
LanguageData.VGE_GiantThruster.description: A massive reinforced astrofuel thruster built for heavy Hellions and orbital support platforms. It greatly increases both range and supported airframe size, but needs a clear exhaust corridor and rare asteroid shielding material. A Hellion can support no more than four.
LanguageData.VGE_SmallOxygenTank.description: A compact oxygen tank that supplies the Hellion's pressure network.
LanguageData.VGE_LargeOxygenTank.description: A high-capacity oxygen tank that supplies the Hellion's pressure network.
LanguageData.VGE_Agrocell.description: An enclosed growing unit designed for Hellion deck plating. Integrated lamps and nutrient feeds conserve space, but crops will die if electrical power is lost.
LanguageData.VGE_JavelinPod.description: A compact six-tube launcher for guided astrofuel missiles. Designed for rapid strikes against exposed Hellions and surface forces, it requires a linked targeting terminal and draws power from the Hellion reactor.
LanguageData.VGE_AnticraftCaster.description: A Hellion-mounted pulse laser that fires short, precise cutting bursts at hostile aircraft and orbital targets. It requires a linked targeting terminal and consumes substantial electrical power.
LanguageData.VGE_Gun_AnticraftCaster.description: A medium Hellion-mounted pulse laser for engaging aircraft and orbital targets.
LanguageData.VGE_CompactStove.description: A compact electric galley range built for Hellion quarters. Its integrated cooktop and preparation surface can also handle butchering, and the unit draws power from the Hellion reactor.
LanguageData.VGE_CompactDrugLab.description: A compact chemistry station built for Hellion compartments. It retains the vessels, heaters, and measuring equipment needed to manufacture chems and draws power from the Hellion reactor.
LanguageData.VGE_CompactMachiningTable.description: A compact machine shop built for a Hellion. It can assemble guns and ammunition or dismantle destroyed robots while drawing power from the Hellion reactor.
LanguageData.VGE_CompactSmithy.description: A compact powered forge built for Hellion workshops. It can produce simple weapons and tools or recover metal from slag while drawing power from the Hellion reactor.
LanguageData.VGE_CompactTailor.description: A compact sewing station built for Hellion quarters. Its powered machine supports rapid clothing production and draws power from the Hellion reactor.
LanguageData.VGE_CompactRefinery.description: A compact biofuel refinery built for a Hellion. It converts wood and plant matter into chemfuel and draws power from the Hellion reactor.
LanguageData.VGE_CompactFabBench.description: A compact precision fabricator built for Hellion workshops. It carries the tooling needed to assemble advanced equipment from simpler parts and draws power from the Hellion reactor.
LanguageData.VGE_CompactResearchBench.description: A compact REPCONN laboratory console designed for narrow Hellion compartments. It provides the capabilities of a full advanced research bench while drawing power from the Hellion reactor.
LanguageData.VGE_CompactMultiAnalyzer.description: A compact analysis computer built to support an advanced research bench aboard a Hellion. Each bench can benefit from only one unit, which draws power from the Hellion reactor.
LanguageData.VGE_CrewBunkBed.description: A compact double-tiered bunk designed for Hellion crew quarters, allowing two people to sleep in the footprint of one bed.
LanguageData.VGE_MedbayBed.description: A Hellion medbay bunk with an integrated vitals monitor. It improves treatment outcomes and draws power from the Hellion reactor.
LanguageData.VGE_CrewLockers.description: A set of compact crew lockers designed for Hellion quarters. Nearby bunks receive a small comfort benefit, but additional locker sets do not stack.
LanguageData.VGE_GravshipShelf.label: Hellion cargo shelf
LanguageData.VGE_GravshipShelf.description: A reinforced cargo shelf built for Hellion compartments. Stored items are secured against movement, do not reduce room beauty, and remain protected from deterioration.
LanguageData.VGE_CommsTerminal.description: A compact radio terminal for contacting factions and orbital traders. It draws power from the Hellion reactor.
LanguageData.VGE_FauxPlant.description: A sturdy pre-War artificial plant that needs no light, water, or air. It adds a little color to sealed Hellion compartments.
LanguageData.VGE_SealantGoop.description: A hardened plug of rapidly expanding aerospace sealant. Fired from an emergency sealant popper, it closes pressure breaches in Hellion compartments but remains brittle and easy to destroy.
